commit_message:
[res] Make sure we properly validate the XML attr size

The old code used to only validate the total size as a product
of a single element size and the number of elements, but that
didn't actually guarantee that there will be that many elements,
as there's a hard limit on a single element size. Setting the
size < min size would pass the product check, but make the
accessing code read beyond the end of memory as it uses min
sizes instead of the specified size
